current_map_layer.official_page_claim: all current planning applications in Haringey
current_map_layer.response_format_issue: The response is labelled GeoJSON but contains an unescaped quotation mark in at least one proposal and is not valid JSON.
current_map_layer.conclusion: The requests prove complete enumeration of the named map layer, but the decided counterexample proves that the layer is not an exact open-case inventory. The later legacy-layer follow-up establishes a credible cross-era discovery union, but not a collectable identity boundary.

legacy_current_map_layer.identity_rule: Address and proposal content matches are diagnostic only and are not accepted as a PKID-to-HGY/Salesforce identity crosswalk.
legacy_current_map_layer.conclusion: The separately named current layers form a credible cross-era discovery boundary, but all 826 legacy PKIDs remain unresolved as official application identities. Complete collection is not verified.

legacy_decided_map_layer.collection_method: Sixteen row-major 4-by-4 whole-borough shape tiles with at least 2.1 seconds between requests to the host.
legacy_decided_map_layer.digest_framing: For each tile in row-major order, the ASCII row:column:response-byte-count plus newline was hashed immediately before the raw response body.
legacy_decided_map_layer.conclusion: The decided layer is a complete unambiguous PKID-to-HGY mapping for its advertised population, but its zero intersection with the 826 legacy-current PKIDs means it supplies none of the required cutover identity crosswalk.

planning_london_datahub.conclusion: The official regional feed supplies HGY and Salesforce identities for covered records but publishes no PKID, omits Salesforce URLs for every FME-legacy and Northgate record, and does not contain the older diagnostic reference. It cannot prove the missing crosswalk or complete historic coverage.

national_planning_data.conclusion: Only the brownfield-land dataset contains PKID links, and none of its 120 authoritative PKID-to-HGY pairs belongs to the 826 legacy-current cohort.

salesforce_sitemaps.conclusion: The sitemap proves a large HGY-to-Salesforce identity inventory but exposes no PKID, so it cannot establish the required upstream PKID-to-HGY join.

crosswalk_result.conclusion: No official machine-readable source exposes a deterministic crosswalk for any member of the required legacy-current cohort.

required_checks.name: legacy-pkid-identity-crosswalk
required_checks.reason: The official legacy links are dead, the current and duplicate planning-alerts maps publish no HGY reference, every official PKID-to-HGY dataset has zero cohort overlap, the GLA and Salesforce machine inventories publish no PKID, PKID is not searchable in Arcus, and neither the FULL guest layout nor the configured public detail payload exposes a legacy identifier.

weekly_refresh_cycles.reason: requires a successful live bootstrap and a genuinely later run
requires a successful live bootstrap and a second genuinely later run

blocker: The portal recovered and proved an inclusive user-defined weekly interval. Separately named and independently reconcilable legacy and Arcus current-map layers provide a credible cross-era older-open discovery boundary, even though both are stale supersets. A machine-first follow-up exhausted both official Haringey map configurations, the GLA Planning London Datahub, all Haringey-managed national Planning Data entities, and the public Salesforce planning sitemaps. The duplicate planning-alerts layer adds no identity; the all-applications layer is server-broken; the GLA publishes no PKID and lacks complete historic coverage; the national brownfield set has zero overlap; and the Salesforce inventory proves HGY-to-record-ID pairs only. All 826 legacy-current PKIDs remain unresolved. The legacy links still target a council host that no longer resolves, Arcus does not search by PKID, and neither its FULL guest layout nor its configured public detail payload exposes a legacy identifier. Address/proposal or geometry matching is not accepted as identity evidence. The 30-day-plus-older-open bootstrap and all dependent qualification checks therefore remain stopped.
